annotations.title: Energy sites and ports watched from orbit

description: Oil refineries, export terminals, LNG plants, fuel depots and oil ports that FirmTape Geo watches by satellite, mainly in Russia, Crimea and the Gulf: NASA FIRMS thermal anomalies at each site measured against that site's own normal, dated Sentinel-2 images (true colour and SWIR, latest and before/after each anomaly) and, for ports, large vessels counted by Sentinel-1 radar as a weekly median against the port's own trailing 8 weeks. Every site has a page to cite. Use when: 'was there a fire at the Tuapse refinery', 'which Russian refineries had thermal anomalies this month', 'how many tankers are waiting at Fujairah'. Not for: strike confirmation. A thermal anomaly is heat seen at a pass (flaring, an upset or a fire read alike); fires put out between passes are missed, and a quiet site is no reading, never proof nothing happened. Images are context, not damage evidence. Limits: the curated list only (about 110 sites); FIRMS from the day each site's watch began.
